name: Level
meaning: unit, database, api, contract, e2e-api, e2e-ui or manual.

name: State
meaning: automated, manual or not automated yet.

name: File
meaning: The file that runs it, from the repo root; required when automated.

name: Manual reason
meaning: Why a person runs it; given when manual, and only then.

name: Name
meaning: Lower-case letters and digits in words joined by single hyphens, such as too-many-children.

name: Severity
meaning: error, warning, or error_or_warning when the check's query says which for each row.

name: Max children
meaning: The most children of one kind a record should hold: a whole number of at least 1.

name: Format
meaning: Always "lathe-theme".

name: Version
meaning: The file format's version, 1.

name: Name
meaning: The theme's name, 1 to 60 characters.

name: Light
meaning: The light set's token values.

name: Dark
meaning: The dark set's token values.

name: Tokens
meaning: Token values shared by both modes.

name: X
meaning: Its left edge, in screen points.

name: Y
meaning: Its top edge, in screen points.

name: Width
meaning: In screen points.

name: Height
meaning: In screen points.

name: Maximized
meaning: Whether it was maximized.

name: Full screen
meaning: Whether it was full screen.

name: Background
meaning: An opaque hex color for the window's background.

name: Foreground
meaning: An opaque hex color for the window's controls.

name: Layout
meaning: tree, nested or voronoi.

name: Depth
meaning: How many levels below the focus the camera frames, 1 to 3.

name: Trace
meaning: Whether trace mode is on.

name: Links
meaning: Whether cross-links to the focus are drawn.

name: Minimap
meaning: Whether the minimap shows.

name: Hidden kinds
meaning: The kinds the filters hide.

name: Hidden relations
meaning: The relations the filters hide.

name: Limit
meaning: The most entities an aggregate should hold.
